provenance.keySource: A question is authenticated when its printed NTA question id is in the 20-05-2026 (First) final key for subject 304 and the key option id is one of its four printed option ids. Printed option ids are consecutive per question.

eliminationNote: Q17, Q44, Q45 and Q46 are called covered by elimination: served material states the facts about three of the four options (or, for Q46, makes the three other diseases recessive) and the answer is the option left over, but no served row or card names the correct option itself. They are marked matchKind concept and their reasons say so; Checker B should rule on them first.
paperStructure: One compulsory Biology paper of 50 questions: Sub-section 1 = 40 single questions (Q391-430), Sub-section 2 = comprehension passage "Drugs and Drug Abuse" with 5 questions (Q431-435) and passage "Mendelian Disorders" with 5 questions (Q436-440). The printed section header says 42 questions, which does not match the 50 ids printed; the key has 50 rows for this shift. None of the ten passage questions can be answered from the passage text (each asks a fact the passage does not print), so none is labelled skill.
